serverInfo.name: smklog-quotes
serverInfo.title: SMKlog Parcel Shipping Rates
serverInfo.description: Live USPS, UPS and FedEx shipping rates for a parcel sent from a US address — inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia — described in plain words. No scale, no account and no API key. Also tracks shipments bought on SMKlog and serves a monthly US parcel shipping price index.

name: com.smklog/parcel-shipping-rates
title: SMKlog Parcel Shipping Rates
description: Live USPS, UPS and FedEx shipping rates for a parcel sent from the US — domestic, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia. Described in plain words, no scale needed.

authentication.note: No key and no account for quoting, tracking or the price index. Rate limited per client.

tools.name: get_parcel_quote
tools.title: Get live US parcel shipping rates
tools.description: Live shipping rates for one US-domestic parcel across USPS, UPS and FedEx. Describe the item in plain words and the packed box size and weight are estimated; give exact dimensions and weight to skip the estimate. Returns up to five purchasable services with the checkout total, the carrier cost beneath it and the SMKlog fee stated separately. Oversized, palletized or crated shipments are priced by a person: clients that declare the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension get a durable task handle (poll it with tasks/get, answers usually take a few business hours); others get a pointer to the human review page. Shipping labels are bought on smklog.com, not through this tool.

annotations.title: Get live US parcel shipping rates

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.title: Create a payment session for a shipping label
tools.description: Prices the shipment live and returns a payment session for buying the shipping label: the amount, and a handoff URL that opens the SMKlog checkout prefilled with this shipment. The human confirms the contents certification and the carrier-adjustment consent there and pays on Stripe hosted checkout. This tool never charges anything itself — MPP intent "session", not "charge".

annotations.title: Create a payment session for a shipping label

tools.name: track_parcel
tools.title: Track a SMKlog shipment
tools.description: Track a shipment whose shipping label was bought on smklog.com, by carrier tracking number. Returns the current delivery status, the latest scan events and the estimated delivery date when the carrier reports one. Works for SMKlog labels only — it is not a universal tracker for arbitrary USPS, UPS or FedEx numbers.

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.title: US parcel shipping price index
tools.description: The SMKlog parcel shipping price index: a monthly repriced basket of six common boxes (1 to 20 lb) shipped from Newark, NJ to five US cities, quoted through the same live USPS, UPS and FedEx pipeline that prices real shipments. Returns the cheapest purchasable service per box and lane with every rate behind it, plus basket averages. Reference data for questions like "what does shipping a shoebox cost in the US right now" — reading it spends no quote allowance. For a price on a specific shipment, call get_parcel_quote instead.
